state: Prespecified prospective assessment of the unchanged V13 algorithm. No order generation or native run is authorized by this protocol alone; root must finalize, commit/push and freeze all sources before a separate first-run authorization.
purpose: Assess the unchanged guardedHiGHSV13 natural full-D0 method against all six unchanged V12-study methods on 144 newly seeded synthetic business scenarios. Preserve initialization, later failures, all lifecycle/deadline evidence, per-baseline completion losses, conditional fees/revisions, and all counterexamples. V14 names this research assessment, not a new V14 scheduling algorithm.

generator.independence: Each business scenario has a unique new base seed across both panels and no overlap with the hash-bound historical seed-exclusion union. Three matching algorithm labels/clock repetitions reuse that business scenario; they are not independent business samples. Disclose duplicate order fingerprints and retain them without replacing infeasible, duplicate, slow or costly inputs.

panels.interpretation: Unchanged V12/V10 generator and shock catalog with one new prespecified generator seed per business scenario. Do not generate, inspect, filter or tune these prospective orders before committed/pushed source freeze and separate root authorization.

Unchanged V12/V10 generator and shock catalog with one new prespecified generator seed per business scenario. Do not generate, inspect, filter or tune these prospective orders before committed/pushed source freeze and separate root authorization.

shockCapacityRule: For each event: capacity=max(0, nominal capacity on revealDay-ceil(nominal*reductionNumerator/reductionDenominator)). Only simulator receives duration. No announcedDuration.

budget.execution: Cold separate POSIX process group per episode; all methods execute serially, cyclic method order changes by scenario and repeat. Python descendants are group-killed on timeout and after worker exit.
budget.clock: Parent time starts before fork; includes imports, planner.ready native startup, all decisions, child terminal dual audit, planner.close cleanup, IPC, parent receipt audit, normal worker exit and parent-confirmed process-group cleanup. A timely final receipt alone is provisional. Completion requires exit code 0, no exit signal, ESRCH confirmation that the whole process group is gone, and cleanup plus the final parent acceptance gate completed within the same 5000ms end-to-end clock. The hard timer remains active after final delivery; real cutoff, exit, close, cleanup and end-to-end times are retained without capping at 5000ms.
budget.callBudgetCaveat: All seven methods receive the unchanged 200ms cooperative whole-call budget. Clone, cache/constructor audit, constructor, seed handling, native IPC/model, complete commitment scoring and final selection share that same daily clock; it is not a hard 200ms function-return guarantee. Native ready/startup and all episode lifecycle work remain in the common cold 5000ms parent clock and are separately reported. No observer or parent acknowledgement changes candidate acceptance.

analysis.repeatAggregation: Pairwise fees: average matching jointly completed repeats within each scenario, then aggregate equal-weight scenario means; also disclose raw episode KRW totals and matching counts. Pairwise revisions retain the original raw changed-event sums over known matching jointly completed episodes and their own known-episode denominator, not scenario-equal-weight revision means. Clock repetitions are not independent confidence-interval samples. Only the all-seven Pareto revision axis averages matching repeats within scenario and aggregates equal-weight scenario means.
analysis.panels: Always separate. Do not pool same-distribution and stress into a ranking.
analysis.defaultGate: V13 observed default eligibility is exactly completePanel && zero full-sample matching-repeat completion losses against each of the other six included methods, evaluated separately for each complete 72-scenario panel. A gain against another method, conditional fee savings, joint Pareto membership or net completion increase cannot cancel a loss. Fee/revision conditions below are separate necessary native-stability claim rules, not an added or removed default-eligibility condition. Passing is an observed necessary gate for these included methods only, not a universal or production recommendation; V5 remains omitted and no V5 non-regression is inferred.
analysis.nativeStabilityClaim: For each native paired comparator separately: conditional stability improvement requires zero comparator completion losses, strictly fewer raw pending-event-date revision events on exactly that pairwise jointly completed episode set with known revisions for every matched episode, and both total/incremental fee 95% savings intervals available and neither wholly negative. Report raw revision sums and their own known matching-episode denominator; do not treat clock repetitions as independent confidence-interval samples. A CI including zero gives no stable fee advantage. No timing or revision-to-KRW conversion.
analysis.revisionUnit: One changed pending pickup/unloadStart/return date; count events, never convert revisions to KRW with invented weights.
analysis.jointCompletePareto: Additional all-seven-method jointly complete matching-repeat subset. Average matching repeats within each eligible scenario, then sum equal-weight scenario means for total/incremental KRW and revision events separately. Show all denominators and full-sample completion. Dominance requires fee/revisions both no worse and one strictly better (EPS 1e-6). Unknown revisions produce null, never zero. No weighted score or pooled ranking.
analysis.initializationRecoverySeparation: Report D0 initial complete-plan acceptance/delivery separately from later execution failure/recovery. Full-path comparisons include different D0 plans; shared-prefix development replay is separate and cannot expand formal holdout denominators.

comparisonGroups.interpretation: All fourteen pairs are fixed before prospective order generation. Only the six primary V13 pairs define V13 completion gates. Secondary pairs retain the old V12 comparator relations on these same new inputs; do not select a favourable comparator or mix pair-specific denominators into a ranking.

defaultGateDefinition.scope: Observed necessary eligibility per separate complete panel, not a universal or production recommendation.

analysis.multiplicity: Fixed per-comparison 95% percentile bootstrap intervals are descriptive marginal intervals. No multiple-comparison correction is applied; they do not establish a joint familywise confidence claim, simultaneous superiority, or a selected best-method ranking.

freezePolicy: Before prospective generation, root must finish old-input implementation/static review, set executionAuthorization.status=ready-for-source-freeze, commit and push the fixed protocol/methods/runner/review sources, then create an exclusive WX frozen source manifest. The manifest binds actual sourceGitCommit/sourceGitTree/gitObjectFormat and verified committed blobs, protocol SHA, all source files, historical seed bindings and metadata-only scenario declarations. No prospective orders are generated by declaration. A separate exclusive first-run execution-start with rootAuthorized=true and source/manifest identities is required before generating any input or launching any optimizer. Runtime imports only frozen sources; no source, parameter, seed, gate or sample changes after seeing results, no implicit resume/retry/replacement.
analysisRules: 144 newly seeded business scenarios (72 per panel) x 3 prespecified clock repetitions x 7 methods = 3024 episodes, not 432 independent business observations.

All seven policies begin at D0 with fresh empty episode state and no imported plan, archived prefix or endpoint intervention. V13 is the existing guardedHiGHSV13 method, not a newly named V14 algorithm.

Keep every initial failure, later execution failure, deadline loss, rejected or late terminal receipt, unknown history, zero denominator, negative savings and completion gain/loss; no filtering/resampling.
Incomplete fees remain null. Missing physical history/call counts/revisions remain null or unavailable, never zero.

A timely audited final is provisional until normal exit and independently recorded ESRCH process-group cleanup finish inside the same 5000ms parent clock. A nonzero exit, signal, unverified cleanup or end-to-end deadline loss rejects that receipt as accepted history; preserve its full original terminal message separately while top-level rows are empty and fees/history/counters unavailable. Receipt delivery timing and whole-lifecycle acceptance are reported separately.

All fourteen prespecified comparisons use each pair's own matching jointly completed repeats. Pairwise fees average within each business scenario before equal scenario weighting and also retain raw episode KRW totals/counts. Pairwise revisions are the original raw event sums over known matching episodes with their own known-episode denominator, not scenario-equal-weight means; clock repetitions are not independent CI samples. Only the all-seven Pareto revision axis averages within scenario before equal scenario weighting. Primary six and secondary eight pairs are labelled in advance.

V13 observed default eligibility is completePanel && zero full-sample matching-repeat completion losses against all six included baselines, separately per panel. Net gains, fees and Pareto membership do not offset any loss. Native fee/revision claim rules are separate and do not change this completion-only necessary gate.

Report two fee numerators/denominators, win/tie/loss, worst losses, all negative IDs, revisions and fixed scenario-cluster bootstrap intervals. Bootstrap conditions on joint completion and cannot remove completion-selection bias.

Separate native conditional stability claims per comparator: zero comparator completion losses, strictly fewer same-pair revisions, both fee intervals available and neither wholly negative. An interval containing zero does not establish stable fee savings.
All-seven joint-complete Pareto subset is separate from pairwise fee sets; report scenario/episode denominators and full-sample coverage. Unknown revisions stay null. No invented fee/revision weight.
Separate D0 initialization coverage/timing from later execution failures. Full-path tests cannot isolate recovery after a shared execution prefix; old-prefix replay remains development evidence.
Original raw native solver seed remains fixed 0; its three algorithm-repeat labels are timing repeats. Do not claim native methods use algorithmSeed unless the actual implementation does.

Only synthetic known-order daily atomic model conclusions are supported. Necessary warehouse commitment bounds do not predict unrevealed capacity or prove robustness; no operational ROI or contest-rank guarantee.
Keep full physical timelines, observation hashes, decisions, all adaptive/native/mandatory-warehouse/seed proofs and failed candidates. Compact only redundant cache-price/debug data.

Freeze after root development-ready declaration; first run and every repetition use exclusive new output. No implicit resume/retry or replacement. Disclose duplicate order fingerprints without resampling.

V12 and V13 maxRestarts=3 enable only four deterministic constructor orders; their algorithmSeed labels do not create stochastic constructor variation. Native seed0 plus deterministic construction makes these clock repetitions, not three independent random-algorithm or business samples.
Use seed800001 and exactly2000 scenario-cluster bootstrap draws. Report unadjusted descriptive marginal intervals; do not claim familywise confidence or select favourable intervals after results.

Do not tune, expand, retry, filter or replace samples after prospective outcomes. A harness defect must retain the first declaration/output/failure, be reported separately and require a new explicit protocol/declaration; no silent repair of a first result.

All V1-V13 sources, protocols, first-run evidence, scores and SHA references remain unchanged. The two-case V13 forced-prefix study and all seen development evidence are excluded from formal V14 sample counts.

deliveryEvidence.policy: Retain unchanged V7/V9 synchronous gates, native audits and the complete V11 necessary-warehouse, V12 constructor and V13 strict-fee guard receipts on every accepted/rejected/failed call.
deliveryEvidence.retention: Full date arrays and current-snapshot fees, public capacity vectors, execution locks, necessary warehouse commitment proof, source selection, accepted/rejected/late candidate records and timing fields. Constructor firstIncumbentMs alone is not acceptance evidence. Include V13 strict-fee guard status, complete incumbent/proposal score inputs/proofs, deadlines and selected action. developmentEndpointImport must be null or absent in every formal trace.
deliveryEvidence.unknownHistory: No timely parent-validated terminal receipt leaves fees/history/counters unknown, never zero. Rejected raw terminal receipts are retained separately and never silently promoted to execution history.

developmentSeparation.previousRuns: All V1-V13 frozen source/protocol/first-run evidence/scores remain unchanged. Previously seen orders and V13 two-case forced-prefix clock replays are development evidence only and do not enter V14 denominators.
developmentSeparation.newSeeds: 791001..791072 and 792001..792072; declared algorithm/clock seeds79011/79023/79039; bootstrap800001. Every commitment is disjoint from the hash-bound historical exclusion union. No prospective order generation before committed/pushed source freeze and separate root run authorization.
developmentSeparation.budgetSelection: Keep all baseline parameters, shared200ms daily and cold5000ms whole-episode limits unchanged; no choice based on prospective outcomes.
developmentSeparation.methodsOmitted: V5/V6/V8-adaptive and CP-SAT are not in this seven-method study; no completion or non-regression inference for omitted methods.

nativeSelectionRule.v11Rule: Same-snapshot equal-fee native proposal can replace valid cache only if complete timely mandatory-warehouse lower-bound score improves. This is a necessary next-day commitment proxy, not robust future feasibility.
nativeSelectionRule.v12Rule: Without a valid audited incumbent, construct a complete execution-locked seed within the first 40ms of the existing whole-call clock (including clone/cache audit), reserve 5ms for constructor acceptance, maxRestarts=3 (four deterministic orders). Feed a timely independently audited complete seed as incumbent; native solve receives only the remaining original 200ms. Existing V11 fee/necessary-warehouse rules compare all valid pre-native incumbents. No constructor-return receipt or extra budget.
nativeSelectionRule.configEquality: All six baseline budgets/configurations remain identical to the V12 formal protocol. V13 uses exactly the V12 budget parameters and frozen V13 implementation; no endpoint-import configuration is supplied, factory default remains disabled. Only the existing strict-fee M non-increase guard differs from V12.
nativeSelectionRule.v13Rule: Retain the unchanged V12 timely audited constructor/native initialization. With an existing timely complete audited incumbent, a strictly cheaper native proposal can replace it only when both complete necessary-warehouse commitment scores finish inside the original call deadline and proposal M is no greater than incumbent M. Equal-fee replacement still requires strict M reduction. Late/incomplete/error scoring retains the audited incumbent. If no audited incumbent exists, do not reject the only complete legal native solution solely for its M. This score is a necessary public next-day commitment proxy, not a private-future forecast, probability, robustness guarantee, or recovery certificate.

executionAuthorization.reason: V14-only implementations and independent static review are ready for committed/pushed source freeze. This protocol alone authorizes no prospective input generation or native execution; the fixed first run still requires separate root runtime authorization.

historicalSeedExclusions.collectionRule: Use the unchanged V12 recursive lexical collector: expand baseSeed/scenarioCount and seedBase/caseCount; include every integer under a key containing seed (including arrays and nested historical exclusions). Conservatively includes bootstrap/native/algorithm integers, not only generator seeds. Source hashes and exact sorted union must be independently verified before freeze and again from the frozen source tree.
historicalSeedExclusions.coverage: V12 historical metadata sources plus the actual V4 summary (five extra historical seeds beyond its old protocol), the full V12 protocol and V13 development protocol; all V2-V13 protocol/development generator commitments are covered without rewriting history.

repeatSemantics.seededHiGHSV12Constructor: maxRestarts=3 uses attempt0..3 deterministic domainSize/deadline/started/highFee orders; seeded random restarts begin only at attempt>=4 and are not enabled. Thus all three V12 runs are timing repeats, not independent stochastic algorithm evidence.
repeatSemantics.statisticalUnit: The business scenario remains the unit; all three repetitions are retained.
repeatSemantics.guardedHiGHSV13Constructor: maxRestarts=3 uses attempt0..3 deterministic domainSize/deadline/started/highFee orders; seeded random restarts begin only at attempt>=4 and are not enabled. Thus all three V13 runs are timing repeats, not independent stochastic algorithm evidence.

executionOrder.caseOrder: Panel order as declared, then mechanisms, capacityProfiles, counts, scenarioRepeat ascending; no data-dependent sorting.
executionOrder.failurePolicy: Continue the predeclared first-run jobs after individual failure; preserve every result and raw receipt. No retries.

candidateSourceBinding.frozenGitCommit: Bound to actual committed/pushed source and verified Git blobs in the subsequent WX freeze manifest, never inferred from this preregistration or a future placeholder commit.

frozenAlgorithmBindingPolicy: The exact seven planner modules and statically reachable local JS dependencies, native Python service, unchanged V12 cold parent/worker and generator are hash-bound here. All old files match their frozen V12 source manifest, and guardedHiGHSV13 matches the first V13 development declaration. The V14 harness/review/materials sources are separately Git-blob/freeze-manifest bound before any prospective generation; they are not declared to be old algorithm files.
